addedSugarG.source: WHO 2015 Guideline: Sugars intake for adults and children; ICMR-NIN 2020 Dietary Guidelines for Indians (<10% of total energy).

satFatG.source: WHO 2023 Guideline: Saturated fatty acid intake for adults and children (<10% of total energy in 2000 kcal diet).

transFatG.source: FSSAI 2021 Regulation / WHO REPLACE: Trans-fatty acids limited to <1% of total energy (<2.2g per day).

sodiumMg.source: WHO 2012 Guideline: Sodium intake for adults and children; ICMR-NIN 2020 RDA (<2,000 mg/day equivalent to 5g salt).

totalFatG.source: ICMR-NIN 2020 Dietary Guidelines for Indians (20-30% of energy intake).

per100gThresholds.source: FSSAI Draft Front-of-Pack Labelling & Indian Food Composition Tables (IFCT) reference criteria.

Frequent.description: Balanced nutrient density, modest sodium and sugar burden, suitable as a frequent meal or snack component.

Moderate.description: Moderate nutritional load. Enjoyable as part of a varied, wholesome diet.

Occasional.description: Elevated level of refined sugars, saturated fats, or sodium. Best reserved for occasional consumption.

Limit.description: High per-serving concentration of sodium, added sugar, trans fat, or saturated fat, or ultra-processed profile.
